observations: A vintage-style domestic sewing machine, light grey/blue in color.
The brand name 'Ideal' is printed on the side of the machine arm.
A matching foot pedal is positioned next to the machine.
The machine has several white control knobs and a red lever.
Image contains a 'POSTED ON JIJI' watermark with the name 'SHARON TAYLOR'.
The machine appears clean on the exterior, but no internal components or the underside are visible.

claims.evidence: The photo shows a clean exterior, but does not confirm mechanical or electrical health.
Requires a demonstration of the motor running and the needle timing being correct.

risks.proof: A video clip of the machine sewing through a piece of fabric.
Photo of the power cord and plug showing no frays or exposed wires.
Photo of all included accessories and the bobbin case area.

proof_requests: Video of the machine powered on and sewing a line of stitches.
Photos of the power cable and the underside/internal bobbin area.
Photo of any included accessories like extra bobbins or presser feet.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as an Ideal brand sewing machine. It can be priced at its worst-case value (non-functional/parts) until proof of operation is provided.
